Definition
[Weak derivative for Banach-space-valued functions] 1. ch5:5.9-def-5\group Bochner Spaces Let $\mathbf{u} \in L^1(0, T; X)$. We say $\mathbf{v} \in L^1(0, T; X)$ is the weak derivative of $\mathbf{u}$, written \[ \mathbf{u}' = \mathbf{v}, \] provided \[ \int _0^T \phi '(t)\mathbf{u}(t)\, dt = -\int _0^T \phi (t)\mathbf{v}(t)\, dt \] for all scalar test functions $\phi \in C_c^\infty (0, T)$.
